title: AI Intelligence & UX Refinements
description: Enhanced AI query generation with world knowledge, improved visualization workflows, and better data presentation.
highlights: AI now uses world knowledge for geographic and common queries
Smarter 'how many' query handling returns actual data instead of just counts
Internal database IDs automatically hidden from users
Improved visualization preview with flexible chart type conversions
Mobile login now works with cross-domain authentication

items.title: World Knowledge Integration
items.description: AI can now use world knowledge to resolve queries without asking for unnecessary clarification
details: Understands geographic regions (West Coast, East Coast, Midwest cities)
Recognizes time periods (last quarter, this year, Q1, etc.)
Infers common categories and industry standards
Only asks for clarification when there's genuine database-level ambiguity

items.title: Intelligent 'How Many' Queries
items.description: Queries asking 'how many X' now return actual records instead of just counts
details: Returns full data with all columns for better analysis
Count is implied by the number of results shown
Only returns bare count when explicitly requested
Consistent behavior across all database types (MongoDB, SQL, SurrealDB)

items.title: Enhanced Ambiguity Handling
items.description: Improved clarity when AI needs user input
details: Provides specific, actionable choices when clarification is needed
Better explanation of why clarification is required
Clearer distinction between world knowledge and database ambiguity

items.title: Hidden Internal IDs
items.description: SurrealDB internal fields are now automatically filtered from query results
details: Removes 'id', '__id', and '_row_order' fields from all results
Cleaner, more user-friendly data display
Applied to both query results and sample data
No configuration required - works automatically

items.title: Improved AI Response Formatting
items.description: AI-generated analysis now displays with proper formatting
details: Unicode bullet points (•) converted to proper HTML lists
Better readability for multi-item responses
Preserves line breaks and formatting
Consistent markdown rendering across all AI responses

items.title: Functional 'Analyze with AI' Button
items.description: The Analyze with AI feature is now fully implemented and working
details: Generates intelligent summaries of query results
Uses original user question for context
Shows loading states during analysis
Displays formatted analysis in results panel
Includes regenerate option for alternative insights

items.title: Enhanced Visualization Preview
items.description: Improved chart type conversion workflow in preview mode
details: Freely convert between chart types and statistics in preview
Original data preserved when converting stat ↔ chart
Automatic restoration of full dataset when converting back
Type-specific styling applied automatically
Restriction only applies to saved dashboard elements

items.title: Smart Chart Conversions
items.description: Intelligent handling of chart type changes
details: Stores original chart data when converting to statistic
Restores complete dataset when converting back to chart
Prevents data loss during experimentation
Applies appropriate styling for each chart type

items.title: Mobile Login Authentication
items.description: Fixed authentication issues on mobile browsers with cross-domain deployments
details: Implemented hybrid authentication supporting both cookies and localStorage
Token now passed via URL parameter after OAuth redirect
Authorization header support for cross-domain API requests
Works seamlessly on both desktop (cookies) and mobile (localStorage)
Solves Safari/iOS strict cookie policies

items.title: SurrealDB Query Syntax
items.description: Fixed count query generation for SurrealDB
details: Corrected aggregation syntax to use SELECT count() instead of array::len()
Added concrete examples to AI prompt for better query generation
Eliminated syntax errors in count queries

items.title: Changelog Display
items.description: Fixed changelog loading issues on Support page
details: Corrected JSON format for v0.5.0 and v0.4.2 changelogs
Added missing release entries for v0.4.0, v0.4.1, and v0.4.2
Ensured consistent schema across all changelog files
Fixed date consistency between releases.json and changelog files

items.title: Improved AI Prompts
items.description: Enhanced system prompts for better query generation
details: Added world knowledge guidelines for all database types
Included 'how many' query examples
Better aggregation syntax documentation
Clearer instructions for ambiguity handling
